name: replay-debugger
title: ReplayDebugger
description: A time travel debugger over Replay recordings read once into JSON: forward and reverse stepping, breakpoints, logpoints, call stacks, scopes and evaluation, a timeline of the whole recording across the top, and for a session of several recordings (a browser and the services behind it) one timeline, a distributed trace as a flame chart, and each request's code step by step beside the page as rrweb saw it. Docstream opens a .replay file in it.
